purpose.zh: 练前腿的大腿和臀部，提升单腿力量
purpose.en: Build the front-leg thigh and glutes for single-leg strength.

text.zh: 身体垂直下沉，前膝对准脚尖
text.en: Lower straight down and keep your front knee over your toes

text.zh: 后脚脚背搭在椅面，前脚跟踩实
text.en: Rest the top of your back foot on the seat and keep your front heel down.

text.zh: 下到前大腿约与地面平行，再用前脚跟推起
text.en: Lower until your front thigh is about parallel, then drive up through the front heel.

commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.

cautions.zh: 使用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
